items.definition:
based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system
The decision seemed arbitrary and unfair.

having the freedom to govern itself or control its own affairs
The region became an autonomous republic.

not discovered or known about; uncertain
His early life remains obscure.

relating to the spine or backbone
He suffered a spinal injury.

relating to the healing of disease
The warm bath had a therapeutic effect.

concerned with the diagnosis of illness or other problems
The doctor ordered several diagnostic tests.

of, relating to, or constituting a difference
There is a differential in pay between the two roles.

relating to the process of evolution
The theory of evolutionary biology explains how species change over time.

never done or known before
The situation was unprecedented.

relating to breathing
Smoking can cause serious respiratory problems.

(of a conclusion or agreement) done or reached decisively and with authority; conclusive
This is the definitive guide to birdwatching.

relating to reproduction
The reproductive system is complex.

morally right
He was a righteous man who always stood up for justice.

pale and weak
She looked wan after her long illness.

emotionally disturbing or distressing
The accident was a traumatic experience for everyone involved.

most important; primary
She is the foremost expert in her field.

based on or relating to a system of ideas and ideals, especially one which forms the basis of economic or political theory and policy
The two parties have significant ideological differences.

relating to the study of religion
He is pursuing a degree in theological studies.

relating to a nerve or the nervous system
Scientists are studying neural pathways in the brain.

relating to space
The architect considered the spatial arrangement of the rooms.

required by statute or law
The company must comply with all statutory regulations.

relating to or denoting the application of scientific methods and techniques to the investigation of crime
The police sent the evidence to the forensic lab.

of, at, toward, or from the side or sides
The building has a lateral extension.

providing supplementary or additional help and support
The ship has an auxiliary engine for emergencies.

relating to sexual desire
The film had some erotic scenes.

referring to itself or to the conventions of its genre; self-referential
The film contained a meta-commentary on the nature of storytelling.

powerful
The drug is very potent, so use it carefully.

relating to a system as a whole
There are systemic issues within the organization.

paramount, supreme
Safety is of paramount importance.

quantitative
We need to conduct a quantitative analysis of the data.

having unlimited power; all-powerful
God is often referred to as the Almighty.

involving two sides or parties
The two countries signed a bilateral agreement.

operated by the pressure of a liquid
The car lift uses a hydraulic system.

causing anger or strong emotion; or causing inflammation
His inflammatory remarks caused a heated debate.

Emitting radiation.
The waste material was highly radioactive.

unstable; likely to change rapidly and unpredictably
The stock market can be very volatile.

relating to electromagnetic radiation with wavelengths longer than those of visible light
The remote control uses infrared signals.

relating to language or linguistics
She has a strong interest in linguistic diversity.

large-scale
We need to consider the macro economic trends.

of similar character
Her situation is akin to mine.

tending to spread harmfully
Invasive species can harm local ecosystems.

relating to the heart and blood vessels
Regular exercise improves cardiovascular health.

clear or obvious to the eye or mind
His joy was manifest in his smile.

extremely thorough, exhaustive, or accurate
The selection process was extremely rigorous, testing candidates on many skills.

(of two or more people) fully in agreement
The jury reached a unanimous verdict after hours of deliberation.

About to happen.
The storm was imminent, so we headed indoors.

Marking the beginning of an institution, activity, or period of office.
The inaugural flight of the new airline was a success.

Intending or intended to do harm.
He spread malicious rumors about his rival.

Relating to an owner or ownership; manufactured and sold only by the owner of the patent or trademark.
The company uses proprietary software for its operations.

easily influenced or harmed by something
Young children are particularly susceptible to colds.

extremely serious or urgent
The situation is dire, and we need to act quickly.

showing sincere and intense conviction
She made an earnest attempt to improve her grades.

extremely important or urgent
It is imperative that we act now to prevent further damage.

relating to or situated on the edge or periphery of something
We need to focus on the main issues, not the peripheral details.

perceptible by touch; clear and definite
We need to see tangible results from this project.

able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities
She is a versatile actress, capable of playing many roles.

Inspiring fear or respect through being impressively large, powerful, intense, or capable.
The team faced a formidable opponent.

not in accordance with the political constitution or with procedural rules
The court ruled the new law was unconstitutional.

relating to or characteristic of a transition
This is a transitional period for the company.

relating to time; worldly rather than spiritual
We live in a temporal world, subject to change.

relating to the immediate surroundings
The restaurant had a pleasant ambient lighting.

having two poles or extremes; relating to bipolar disorder
The doctor diagnosed him with bipolar disorder.

relating to or involving computation
The problem requires advanced computational methods to solve.

relating to or based on concepts
The artist's work is highly conceptual and thought-provoking.
